node.title: Why Selection Cannot See It
node.reading:
Insolvency, positive deviation, and a case (Nokia) in which market and evolutionary predictions pointed confidently in the wrong direction — the case that motivates the claim that the two instruments are complementary, not rival. Why selection does not refute this theory; it nests inside it.

Builds on Paper 1 ( The Map and the Flow ) and Paper 2 ( Rationality, Coherence, and the Frame ). This paper supplies the dynamics — insolvency and the closed-system destiny — and the central defense: the rival most likely to topple the theory, evolutionary / market selection, does not reach it. Nokia is the witnessed, motivating case used to show the two instruments are complementary, not rival; it is not a causal account of why any firm declined. The forward forecasts (the Outlook) and the consolidated falsification battery are deferred to later papers in the series; falsifiable claims are marked inline.

relations: An operationally useful solution must meet its response window, not merely exist in the feasible set.
La viabilidad económica de una organización y el deadline de un planificador son fenómenos distintos; sólo comparten la distinción entre posibilidad y utilidad efectiva.
Process conformance identifies a path difference; outcome and counterfactual evidence are still needed to establish whether the deviation preserved the upstream result.
No canonizar heroísmos, fraude ni atajos inseguros por producir una salida local. El marco receptor debe permanecer explícito.
The forecast becomes testable by asking whether automation creates more compensatory work in processes already dependent on off-map reconciliation.
Es pronóstico condicionado. Cambios de volumen, regulación, demanda y riesgo pueden explicar el trabajo nuevo.
Off-path frequency is a screening measure; load-bearing positive deviation requires evidence that the upstream outcome depended on that path.
La dependencia causal requiere más que conformance checking y no se obtiene suponiendo positiva toda excepción exitosa.
For a complementary reading, see [Selection, positive deviation and capability survival](https://tegrity.ai/why-selection-cannot-see-it/).
For a complementary reading, see [The School of Invisible Talent](https://jubap.net/the-formacion-integral-jubap-net-school-of-invisible-talent/).
